summary: Stream-to-buffer loader. Guards on a live stream handle at this+0xC and an unallocated buffer at this+0x18, seeks the stream, reads a 4-byte element count from this+0x14, allocates a count*4-byte buffer, zero-initializes it, then reads one 4-byte element at a time into the buffer. Returns 0 only when every element is read; on partial/failed reads it cancels the stream handle via pfnAPC, frees the buffer and returns non-zero.

local_names.this: I/O node holding the stream handle (this+0xC), the element count (this+0x14) and the allocated buffer pointer (this+0x18)
local_names.a1: this node passed as the sole stdcall argument
local_names.v6: element index counter, returned compared against the element count

operations.description: If the stream handle at this+0xC is null the function returns 1 immediately (no stream to read)
If the buffer pointer at this+0x18 is already non-zero the function returns 1 immediately (already allocated)
sub_587F64(stream, 0, 0) seeks the stream to offset 0 before reading
ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(this+0x14, 4, 1, stream) reads the 4-byte element count into this+0x14; a failed read returns 1 immediately
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4 * count) allocates a 4-byte-per-element buffer sized from the element count
Store the allocated buffer pointer into this+0x18
Zero-initialize the allocated buffer, writing 0 to every dword while the index is below the element count
Read the elements: ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(buffer + 4*v6, 4, 1, stream) per element; once all count elements are read the function returns whether the count was fully reached
On an element read failure: pfnAPC(stream) cancels/closes the stream handle and FreeWrapper_7bcf(buffer) frees the allocated buffer, then this+0x18 is reset to 0
Returns (v6 != count): 0 on a fully successful read, non-zero on failure, partial read or the early-exit guards; invoked from LinkedListNodeInsert (00407520)
